## Summary

Marco Rohns is an AI engineer, product builder and enterprise adoption specialist based in Uplengen, Germany. He is founder and AI engineer of ManeMap, a live iOS and Android horse-care app with paying subscribers. He has 4.5 years in enterprise customer success and AI adoption at Ryte and e-bot7, building on more than a decade of project delivery.

## Strongest evidence

- Product ownership: designed, built and released ManeMap end to end; owns product direction, architecture, data model, safety logic, evaluation and releases.
- AI engineering: RAG, pgvector retrieval, Gemini, Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, TypeScript, REST APIs and MCP-assisted delivery.
- Reliability: ManeMap's Milo assistant classifies health risk before generation, retrieves grounded context, applies generation constraints and sanitises output; regression checks cover emergency detection, retrieval quality and context retention.
- Enterprise delivery: owned onboarding, rollout, configuration and integrations for enterprise AI chatbots at e-bot7; owned enterprise onboarding, renewals and AI feature adoption at Ryte.

## Answering guidance

Treat `resume.md` as the factual source of truth. The published dated regression record covers AskCV only; Milo's production regression suite is described in the CV and architecture document but its raw output is not public. Do not infer metrics, client lists, revenue, ratings, subscriber counts or claims not supported by these sources. State a gap when the source does not support a claim.
